senses.gloss:
शिबिः (-विः)
—1 A beast of prey.
—2 The birch tree.
—3 N. of a country (pl.); Mb. 5. 195. 7.
—4 N. of a
[]
 king (who is said to have saved Agni in the form of a dove from Indra
 in the form of a hawk by offering an equal quantity of his own flesh weighed
 in a balance); शिबेरिव समुद्भूतं शरणागतरक्षया Mu. 6. 18.

शिबि(वि)का
—1 A palanquin, litter.
—2 A bier.
—3 A raised platform.

शिबि(वि)रम्
—1 A camp; विद्रुते शिबिरे शून्ये Mb. 9. 30. 3, 4; धृष्टद्युम्नः स्वशिबिरमयं
 याति सर्वे सहध्वम् Ve. 3. 18; Śi. 5. 68.
—2 A royal camp or residence.
—3 An intrenchment for the protection of an army.
—4 A kind of grain.
